title: Replying to @Bill it’s so fun though 🤣 #dollyparton #dollymusical #do...
transcript: I'm gonna be so for real y'all have to add some whimsy to your life I just got back from Nashville where I saw the Dolly Parton musical which is a bio musical about the life of Dolly Parton co written by Dolly Parton I'm gonna do a video later about the things that I think it could do better at but like the one thing that it nails perfectly is the tone and yes it ends the show with like a 50 foot Dolly Parton singing some of her biggest hits while the entire cast is around the giant projection of Dolly Parton it's a delight and yes it is over the top and ridiculous but when has Dolly Parton not been over the top and ridiculous it is a perfect encapsulation of who Dolly is what brings her joy and what her fans want like it would have been wild not to end the show with a Dolly cameo of some sort and this show is really just a love letter from Dolly to her fans to the people who have supported her to her family to the people who made Dolly Dolly and I just think the bows are kind of perfect and I would take an over the top ridiculous bio musical every single day over just like another run of the mill kind of sleepy bio musical
classificationReason: Reply-to-comments video about the Dolly Parton bio musical in Nashville, which is not on the provided Broadway/West End list.
